description_en: Decrypts data by using the private key of an asymmetric CMK
description_zh: 使用非对称密钥进行解密
kebab_example: aliyun kms asymmetric-decrypt --ciphertext-blob  --key-id key-hzz630494463ejqjx0000 --key-version-id 2ab1a983-7072-4bbc-a582-584b5bd80000 --algorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AsymmetricDecrypt

parameters.help_en:
The ciphertext to be decrypted. The ciphertext is encoded in Base64.

You can generate a ciphertext by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148131.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
解密密文，使用Base64编码。 

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148131.html接口生成密文
parameters.name: ciphertext_blob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify the alias or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key. For more information about aliases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.

When you access a key in another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the key. The ARN of a key is in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}` format
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the key version. The globally unique identifier of the key version
parameters.help_zh: 密钥版本ID。密钥版本的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: key_version_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run feature.

true: enables the dry run feature.

false: disables the dry run feature. This is the default value.

The dry run feature is used to test API calls, verify the permissions on the specified resources, and check the validity of the request parameters. If you enable the dry run feature, KMS always returns a failure response and the cause of the failure. The causes of the failure include the following:

DryRunOperationError: The request would have succeeded if the DryRun parameter is not specified.

ValidationError: The specified parameter in the request is invalid.

AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run
